Description: The system shall accept input of clinical data including YMRS, HDRS, episode duration, and behavioral observations.
The system shall predict the likelihood of manic, depressive, or euthymic states using ML models.
The system shall provide interpretable outputs (e.g., risk score, feature importance).
The system shall store patient records securely with anonymization.
The system shall generate alerts for high-risk episodes.
The system shall support multi-user access (clinician, admin, patient view).
